segments.name: healthcare services
segments.description: Sells Medicare Advantage plans and coordinates care for seniors.
segments.evidence: We operate and manage the business as one reportable segment and one operating segment, which is to provide healthcare services to our seniors.

revenueModel.text: The federal government pays monthly premiums for members under its CMS contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Premium revenue is derived monthly from the federal government based on our contracts with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services ("CMS").
